meta_description: GT Drains is your trusted emergency plumber in Sunderland. Fast response, drain clearance, burst pipes & heating repairs. Call now for same-day service.
hero_eyebrow: 24/7 Emergency Response — Rapid Drain & Plumbing Fixes
hero_subhead: Blocked drain at 3am or burst pipe on Sunday? We're here within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Drainage Services Across Sunderland
services_subhead: From emergency call-outs to planned installations, we handle every plumbing job with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Drain Clearance
services.desc: Blocked drain causing backups? We locate the blockage with CCTV cameras and clear it fast—no mess left behind. Available 24/7 for urgent jobs.

services.title: Burst Pipe Repairs
services.desc: Water pouring from a burst pipe? Our team isolates the leak, makes the repair, and restores your water supply. We carry emergency parts on the van.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Repair
services.desc: New boiler or existing system on the fritz? We install high-efficiency models and fix faults fast, keeping your home warm and reducing energy bills.

services.title: Radiator Replacement
services.desc: Cold radiators or old models wasting heat? We remove, install, and balance your heating system for even warmth throughout your home.

services.title: Tap & Leak Repairs
services.desc: Dripping taps costing you money and sleep? We fix or replace taps, repair under-sink leaks, and stop water waste before it ruins your bills.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Planning a new bathroom or kitchen? We handle pipework, supply lines, waste disposal, and ensure everything passes inspection.

about_pullquote: I started GT Drains because I couldn't stand watching neighbours charged over the odds for simple fixes.
about_para_1: GT Drains was founded on the principle that emergency plumbing shouldn't mean a massive bill or a long wait. With over 15 years' experience across Sunderland, we've built our reputation on arriving fast, fixing right the first time, and treating your home with respect. Every job—whether a blocked drain at midnight or a planned boiler install—gets the same level of care.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we don't overcharge, we don't pressure you into unnecessary work, and we show up when we say we will. Word-of-mouth keeps us busy, and that's exactly how we like it. If something needs a proper fix, we'll tell you straight; if it can wait until morning, we'll say so.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Homeowners Say About GT Drains

reviews.text: Had a blocked toilet at 11pm on a Friday. Called GT Drains expecting the worst, but they had someone round by midnight. Clean job, fair price, no faffing about. Absolute lifesaver.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Burst pipe in the kitchen last month. Rang them in a panic and they were here in 45 minutes. Fixed it properly, not a bodge. Best £180 I've spent. Will use them again without hesitation.
reviews.author: Claire W.

reviews.text: New boiler install went smoothly. They explained everything clearly, finished on time, and the paperwork was sorted. No dramas. Heating's brilliant now and bills are noticeably lower.
reviews.author: David M.
